short: My computer has a virus or is locked
title: My computer has a virus or is locked: what you can do now
pageTitle: My computer has a virus or is locked (ransomware): what you can do now | Spamlock
description: Computer slow, full of pop-ups, or locked with a demand for money (ransomware)? Steps you can take now: disconnect, don’t pay, run a scan, restore a backup and look for a free unlock tool.
answer: Disconnect from the internet. If a message demands money to unlock your files, don’t pay. Run a full antivirus scan, restore your files from a backup, and check No More Ransom for a free unlock tool.
stepsTitle: Steps you can take if your computer has a virus or is locked

steps.title: Disconnect from the internet
steps.text: Turn off Wi-Fi or unplug the cable. This stops the problem spreading to your other devices.

steps.title: Locked with a demand for money? Don’t pay
steps.text: Paying doesn’t guarantee you get your files back, your computer stays infected, and you’re more likely to be targeted again. Take a photo of the message: it helps identify the problem.

steps.title: Not confident? Get help
steps.text: From the maker’s support, a computer shop you trust, or someone you know who’s good with computers. Never from someone who contacts you first offering to fix it.

steps.title: Run a full scan
steps.text: Install the latest updates, then run your antivirus and follow its advice. On a Mac, update macOS and restart: it removes known malware when it restarts.

steps.title: Still not fixed? Wipe and reinstall
steps.text: If the scan can’t clean it, the computer needs wiping and everything reinstalled. You may need expert help for this.

steps.title: Restore your files from a backup
steps.text: Only after the computer is clean, from a backup made before the problem started.

steps.title: No backup? Look for a free unlock tool
steps.text: No More Ransom has free tools that unlock some kinds of ransomware. Not every kind has a tool yet.

steps.title: Report it
steps.text: To the police. In the UK, to Report Fraud.
